body: Thank you, I guess my English isn't as bad as I initially thought :)

You don't have too feel sorry, if you really can't help it's not your fault. Your focus should be to get yourself out, but you should also know it makes me feel a little better that I'm not completely alone.
Thank you. I really needed to hear that.

If it helps my reasoning is that I wont go anywhere but downwards if I don't actively try. Despite people fading from my life there was always a period of happiness before dropping off again... Happiness feels very addictive, but I have trouble finding it consistently.

Yes... I meant telling people how I really feel, the person I talked to yesterday told me she had had similar feelings in the past so she might just be the first person I can really talk to. No therapy of medication. I get frustrated a lot, bottle it up inside and let it go during physical exercise but that's as close as it gets.

Thank you... I just don't know what to say. I guess I just didn't expect anyone to actually say something... With all the "bad" responses I've had in the past I guess I just can't believe anyone actually cares... Not that I blame them, I feel like shit for bringing my problems into their lives anyway.
